question: Does the deterministic CRT curve-choice policy produce rational two-point relations across the first eight prime fields with comparable subgroup orders?

field_selection.eligibility: nonsingular base curve and largest prime factor r of #E(F_p) in [43,80]
field_selection.take: first eight eligible primes in increasing order, using only the group order

subgroup_policy.order: largest prime factor of the full base-curve group order

target_policy.admission: both sampled points nonidentity and distinct

curve_choice_policy.search: same centered-residue order and exact rational CRT reconstruction as the pinned parent panel

recovery: w=(t1+2t2)/3 mod r followed by scalar replay
raw_rows: deterministic gzip JSONL shards by blocks of eight t1 values
claim_boundary: field-specific exact finite-panel yield and candidate probes; no pooled success-rate or wall-time comparison
